2. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 — the most recent release that was healthy in production — across all regions.
3. **Verified recovery**: v2.3.0 is now live in all three regions, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** INC-0001 ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0"), which has paged the on-call engineer. The incident describes the failure, the rollback mitigation, and notes that root-cause investigation of v2.3.1 is needed before any redeployment attempt.
